summary: The opening bounce is holding, with the Nifty back above 23,000 and the Sensex up roughly 0.9%, as IT heavyweights do the lifting while broader markets stay muted.

detail.tone: Little changed from the opening note: gains have held and IT has taken over leadership, with Infosys up about 3.3% and TCS about 2.7%.
